detail.longDescription: Meta's Pocket app lets anyone create interactive games by typing prompts, but the creations are locked inside Meta's platform with no way to export them. The AI does the heavy lifting, but users don't own what they build. https:// arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/08 /pockets-ai-made-my-game-ideas-real-now-meta-controls-the-results/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AgenticAI
